title: centaurea jacea subsp. weldeniana
intro: Centaurea jacea subsp. weldeniana, commonly known as Mountain Knapweed or Weld's Centaury, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This perennial plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea jacea subsp. weldeniana include its ability to act as an anti-spasmodic, an anti-inflammatory, and an antioxidant, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
